question: Bloodlord of Vaasgoth gives bloodthirst to Vampire creature spells. If I cast Phantasmal Image, which enters as a copy of a Vampire creature, is it a Vampire creature spell?

expected.shortAnswer: No: a creature spell that may enter as a copy of a creature isn't a Vampire creature spell, even if you copy a Vampire.
expected.answer: A creature spell like Phantasmal Image that may enter as a copy of a creature is not a Vampire creature spell, even if you intend on copying a Vampire creature when that creature enters.
